value.rationale: The positive-gap isolated chords are a natural rare component class of the uniform circle graph. Their count converges to zero in probability while its covariance with a macroscopic crossing count stays at -1/3. The exact stratified formula and controlled all-gap sum are structurally motivated and nontrivially distinguish rare-event convergence from covariance convergence.
